deploy.startCommand: echo '[start] prisma db push...'; npx --no-install prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss || true; echo '[start] seeding...'; node prisma/seed-prod.cjs || true; echo "[start] launching next on 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-3000}"; exec npx --no-install next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p ${PORT:-3000}
